messages:
maria-sr-sales: Heads-up — BankCorp wants an air-gapped POC but they also require incremental patching without Internet. Can we ship a signed delta bundle and an offline apply runbook?

ali-solutions: Yep, feasible. We need to confirm two things: 1) signer/key provenance (they want customer-held signing or our signed bundles + attest). 2) delta format — do they accept our binary diffs or want full image swaps?

devon-eng: For delta we'd use our minibundle format (chunked tar + manifest). It supports patch-level diffs and resumable transfers. We sign the manifest with our Notary key.

sophie-security: BankCorp asked for FIPS-compatible signing + HSM-backed key storage. If they hold the HSM, we can generate customer-signed manifests. Otherwise we can provide HSM-backed signing as a paid add-on (audit trail + key custody).

maria-sr-sales: Important: procurement prefers us *not* to ship a networked bootstrap that calls home. All install artifacts must be self-contained. Ops will be offline.

ops-engr: That's fine. We provide an offline operator image, an apply script, and a verify utility. Verify uses SHA256 checksums and the manifest signature. Example verify snippet: ```sh
sha256sum -c bundle.sha256
./verify-manifest --pubkey bankcorp.pem bundle.manifest.sig
```

ali-solutions: Also flag: upgrade cadence question. BankCorp expects quarterly security patches + emergency hotfixes. We should propose a default delta cadence (quarterly) and SLA for hotfix turnarounds.

maria-sr-sales: They asked for pricing on two lines: POC engineering + ongoing offline-support subscription for signed bundles/ops. Can we get rough numbers?

devon-eng: Rough: POC eng (2 wks eng + 1 wk validation) ~$35k. Offline bundle support subscription (signed bundles, 4 patches/year, priority hotfixes) starting at $20k/year. Exact SOW subject to scope.

sophie-security: Add-on: customer-held HSM integration and attestation service + yearly key rotation runbook is another line item (~$8k setup, $5k/year ops).

maria-sr-sales: Thanks. I'll put those into the proposal. One more blocker: legal wants to know if our minibundles include telemetry. BankCorp will not accept any telemetry leaving the site.

devon-eng: No telemetry by default in offline bundles. We strip metrics and disable any outbound probes. The only metadata is the signed manifest and checksums.

maria-sr-sales: Perfect. Next: Sophie can you answer the security questionnaire item "Do you allow customer-managed signing keys?" — need a one-liner for the form.

sophie-security: One-liner: "Yes — Redwood supports customer-managed signing keys (HSM/KMS) for offline bundle signing via a documented key-injection and attestation process."

ali-solutions: I'll draft a short runbook for on-site engineers: packing checksum tool, transfer validation steps, apply sequence, rollback instructions. Will attach to the SOW.

maria-sr-sales: Great. @deploy-bot can you create a POC bundle request ticket for BankCorp with tags: offline, customer-hsm, delta-patching?

deploy-bot: POC bundle request created: POC-2026-0418 (BankCorp). Assigned to devon-eng. ETA: 5 business days for initial bundle.

maria-sr-sales: Awesome — I'll update the commercial proposal and security questionnaire with these lines. If any legal/security redlines come up I'll loop you all in. :thumbsup:

ali-solutions: One quick nuance — if BankCorp wants encrypted minibundles (at-rest AES-256), we support that; we just need key exchange details (sneakernet or KMS wrap).

maria-sr-sales: Flagged. I'll ask procurement for their preferred key delivery method.

ops-engr: For the runbook: also include the checksum fallback in case transfer is interrupted: use `rsync --partial --inplace` for large USB transfers, then re-run verify.

devon-eng: Noted. I'll attach the minibundle spec and sample `bundle.sha256` layout to the ticket.

maria-sr-sales: Thanks everyone — closing thread for now. I'll post updates in the BankCorp deal thread when procurement responds. :thumbsup:
